exposition_seal.compressed_statement: Fix one level and deterministic unit trailing directions. Under the actual unconditioned joint standard Gaussian on all coefficient blocks, the literal uncut angular polynomial is centered Gaussian with variance n times the sum of the squared source amplitudes.

TYPING: u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val)
STANDING: The paper chooses sufficiently large n and a specified depth h(n). The isolated identity holds for any positive n and natural h, without changing the paper's admissible family.

The full stdGaussian measure is concrete; independence, a.e. measurability and moments are conclusions of intermediate proof steps, not additional binders.
